maya: quick heads-up — ran a mixed AWQ+SmoothQuant bring-up on 13B-llamaX with 64k context. observed a consistent quality delta vs fp16 at long lengths (>=16k) — ppl jump ~+3.6 absolute (~+10% relative). p95 latency looks fine. posting minimal logs.

zach: which quant recipe and calib size?

maya: used AWQ+SmoothQuant pipeline we tried last week. calib=4096, per-head scaling enabled, smooth_alpha=0.5, act-stabilizer enabled in quantizer. command: ```
python tools/quantize.py --model /models/13B-llamaX --out /tmp/q13b --method awq --smoothquant --act-stabilizer --calib 4096 --per_head_scale True --fold_act True
```

anika: hmm. two quick things: 1) try lowering smooth_alpha to 0.25 (sq has been over-smoothing some heads in longctx), 2) run per-layer recalib with 8k random sequences (layerwise stats change at 32k+). also dump activation histos for suspicious layers.

devbot: deploy-bench: job/job-4721 completed — p95=118ms, throughput=6.2 tok/s, exit_code=0

zach: also try disabling fold_act (set --fold_act False) for AWQ so act quant params stay separate. add a clamp parameter: --act_clamp 6.0 to limit extreme values. per-head scale clipping at 3.0 helped us before.

maya: noted. one oddity: token-level error clusters around early-mid prefix tokens when sequence >50k. could be KV cache reuse/offset. regen test shows divergence after ~58k tokens. sample snippet: ```
FP16: ... "and then the result was stable"
AWQ+SQ: ... "and then result was" (truncated, divergence)
```

anika: that sounds like KV eviction/offset bug or attention cache mis-indexing. can you run regen with `--force-kv-verify` and an increasing prefix window? I'll run per-head activations on layer 21-24.

zach: small script to dump act histos: ```
python tools/dump_acts.py --model /tmp/q13b --layers 20-24 --out /tmp/acts.tgz --samples 1024
```

maya: uploading logs + dumps to s3: s3://redwood-dev/experiments/sq-awq/2334506789/logs.tar.gz. I'll spin three variants tonight: (A) alpha=0.25 + per-layer recalib(8k), (B) fold_act=False + clamp=6.0, (C) per-head-clip=3.0 + no act-stabilizer. will post aggregated eval table tomorrow.

anika: :thumbsup: if you can include the eval harness (longctx regen + QPPL + exact-match buckets) I'll run cross-checks in the morning. also add a few adversarial prefixes (repeats/whitespace heavy).

maya: thanks — will do. tagging @eng-runtime for perf regression watch. closing loop tomorrow AM.
